guys there is a difference between “ok” and “okay”

Sometimes “I’m okay” doesn’t mean I’m okay. Sometimes it means I still have kids to take care of, things that need done, people depending on me, and a life that doesn’t exactly stop just because I’m overwhelmed. There are days when you don’t feel strong. You’re not being positive. You’re not handling everything gracefully. You’re literally just doing what needs to be done because… what other option is there? So when someone asks, “Are you okay?” sometimes the most accurate answer really is: I don’t have a choice.  Anyway. Cheers to everyone currently functioning out of pure obligation and caffeine. ☕️  #Relatable #MomTok #RealLife #Overwhelmed #CoffeeTok
